text:
Marta: Quick sync — we need a concrete proposal for SLO-driven routing + model-variant fallbacks. Customers expect tiered latency/availability SLAs and we need clear CB thresholds and console UX to expose what's happening.
Sandeep: +1. Can you state target SLOs per tier? e.g. free: p95 < 300ms/availability 98%, pro: p95 < 120ms/99.9%, enterprise: p95 < 80ms/99.95%?
Marta: Yes, those approx numbers. Important: when primary model misses SLO we should fallback to cheaper/slower variant vs a cross-region fallback depending on customer tier and quota. Need policy semantics.
Ryan: Proposal idea: routing policy with three axes — tier, region, model_variant_priority. Circuit-breaker uses rolling-window error/latency ratio and an explicit SLA breach budget. Example policy YAML:
```
policy:
  tier: pro
  slo:
    p95_latency_ms: 120
    availability: 99.9
  cb:
    window_sec: 60
    breach_pct: 5   # if >5% of requests exceed slo in window
    cooldown_sec: 120
  fallback_order:
    - model: gptx-8q
    - model: gptx-4q
    - action: region-failover
```
Alia: Two callouts — (1) quota/burst interplay: if fallback lands on a model with different cost/quota we must surface expected token cost and throttle. (2) when circuit breaker trips, console should show recent example traces + request ids for debugging.
Joe: Also think about rollout UX: a toggle to enable 'soft fallback' where we route X% of traffic to fallback first to measure quality/regressions (canary for fallback path).
deploy-bot: canary-rollout started by Joe for policy-refactor #724: 5% -> 20% over 2h. logs at https://deploys.local/724
Sandeep: For route-decisions we need an internal debug endpoint: `/debug/route?req_id=...` returns decision tree, metrics used, and which rule fired. Pseudocode for decision-time scoring:
```
score = base_priority
if latency_estimate > slo.p95: score += penalty
if model.cached_prefix: score -= cache_bonus
if tier == enterprise: score += tier_boost
choose model with lowest score
```
Marta: Nice. Action items: Ryan — add YAML schema + API change PR for `/route-decide` (owners: eng-platform). Alia — telemetry dashboard mock showing per-tier p95, cb hits, fallback counts. Sandeep — implement cb logic + unit tests and a golden-path sim. Joe — UX copy for 'soft fallback' and confirmation modal.
Ryan: I'll sketch the console panel by EOD and put a prototype in figma. Also adding a small column in routes table: `CB state` with tooltip and `why` link.
Alia: I'll own the telemetry panel and will stub dashboards in Grafana with synthetic data for the sim.
Marta: Cool — let's sync tomorrow 10:30. If anyone wants to change SLO numbers speak now, otherwise we'll bake those into the policy draft. :thumbsup:
